translations.zh-Hant: 之前的模型設定讀不出來，沒有搬過來；請重新新增服務商。
translations.en: Your earlier model setting couldn’t be read and wasn’t carried over. Add a provider again.

translations.zh-Hant: 可不填，預設用網址的主機名

translations.en: Paste the key from your provider

translations.zh-Hant: 不需要 Key 的服務可不填
translations.en: Optional if the service needs no key

translations.zh-Hant: 介面網址要以 https:// 開頭；渥屋助理只用加密連線送出 Key 和對話。
translations.en: The base URL must start with https://; this app sends keys and chats only over encrypted connections.

translations.zh-Hant: 這是「%1$@」的官方網址，用它的預設更省事：網址和介面型別都已填好。
translations.en: This is %1$@’s official address. Its preset fills in the address and interface type for you.
the saved key couldn’t be read

translations.zh-Hant: 網址、模型名或 Key 的格式不對
translations.en: the address, model name or key isn’t valid

translations.zh-Hant: API Key 無效或沒有權限
translations.en: the API key is invalid or has no access

translations.zh-Hant: 找不到這個網址或模型
translations.en: the address or model wasn’t found

translations.zh-Hant: 請求太頻繁，請稍後再試
translations.en: too many requests; try again later

translations.zh-Hant: 服務商拒絕了這個請求
看不懂回傳的內容，請確認介面網址
translations.en: its reply couldn’t be read; check the base URL

translations.zh-Hant: 服務要求轉址；為了保護 Key 已停止
translations.en: the service asked to redirect, so the test stopped to protect the key
couldn’t connect to the model service

translations.zh-Hant: 渥屋助理會按你填的位址和 Key 存下這家服務商，不列模型、也不試呼叫。渥屋助理做事需要會呼叫工具的模型，沒測過的這一家可能連不通，也可能不會呼叫工具。存下之後可以在服務商頁「重新測試」。
translations.en: This app will save this provider with the address and key you entered, without listing models or making a test call. It needs a model that can call tools to get things done, and an untested one may not connect or may not call tools. You can test it later from the provider’s page.

translations.zh-Hant: 已存下 %1$@，沒有測試過。它標著「沒測試過」；選一個模型時會先試呼叫，也可以在服務商頁「重新測試」。
translations.en: %1$@ was saved without a test. It’s marked as not tested; pick a model to check it, or test it again from the provider’s page.

translations.zh-Hant: 「測試並儲存」會用填的模型送出一句固定的測試訊息，有回覆才儲存；不會送出你的對話，但服務商可能收取少量費用。
translations.en: “Test and save” sends one fixed test message to the model you entered and saves only if it replies. Your chats aren’t sent, though the provider may charge a little.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒有儲存：要用 %1$@，需要先同意把內容傳給它。
translations.en: Not saved: to use %1$@, you need to agree to send your content to it first.

translations.zh-Hant: 思考和辦事都靠它。選支援工具呼叫的模型，辦事才靠得住。
translations.en: Does all the thinking and acting. Pick a model with tool calling so tasks go reliably.

translations.zh-Hant: 還沒有可選的模型。先新增一個服務商。
translations.en: No models to choose from yet. Add a provider first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這一版還不會向服務商要模型列表。在服務商下面填它說明文件裡的模型名，按「使用」會先試呼叫一次，通了才換。
translations.en: This version doesn’t ask providers for their model lists yet. Under a provider, enter a model name from its docs; “Use” makes one test call first and switches only if it works.

translations.zh-Hant: 點一個模型，可以把它用作主模型，或設定它能不能看圖。
translations.en: Tap a model to use it as the main model or say whether it can see images.

translations.zh-Hant: 這家是跳過測試存下的，還不知道能不能用。選一個模型時會先試呼叫，也可以點「重新測試」。
translations.en: This provider was saved without a test, so nothing is known about whether it works. Pick a model to test it, or tap “Test again”.

translations.zh-Hant: 這家的 API Key 會一起刪掉。
translations.en: Its API key will be deleted too.
%1$@ uses it; you’ll need to choose again after deleting.

translations.zh-Hant: 它沒在給任何用途幹活。
translations.en: It isn’t used for any role.

translations.zh-Hant: 已刪除「%1$@」和它的 API Key。
設定已儲存，但舊的 API Key 沒能刪掉；下次開啟 App 會再清一次。
translations.en: Saved, but the old API key couldn’t be deleted; the app tries again the next time it opens.

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@（%2$@）會收到下面這些內容，好讓它的模型回覆你：
translations.en: %1$@ (%2$@) will receive the following so its model can reply:

translations.zh-Hant: 你在對話裡輸入的文字
附件在這台裝置上讀出的文字（每個檔案最多 32 KB，一則訊息合計最多 64 KB）
translations.en: Text read from your attachments on this device (up to 32 KB per file and 64 KB per message)

translations.zh-Hant: 打開「能看圖」時，你附上的圖片
translations.en: Photos you attach, when “Can see images” is on

translations.zh-Hant: 跟對話一起送出的個人檔案
translations.en: Your profile, sent along with conversations

translations.zh-Hant: 研究網站或執行任務時讀到的網頁文字
translations.en: Text of web pages read during research and tasks

translations.zh-Hant: 研究網站時，請模型判斷結果的請求
translations.en: Requests during research that ask the model to judge the results

translations.zh-Hant: 加進對話的記憶搜尋結果
translations.en: Memory search results added to the conversation
The content of skills that are used

translations.zh-Hant: 開啟「自動記住我說過的事」時，每次回覆後自動整理記憶的請求，含你說的話和相關的記憶
translations.en: With “Remember what I say automatically” on, the request after each reply that organizes your memories, with what you said and related memories

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 工具和資源回傳的結果
translations.en: Results from MCP tools and resources

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@ 是你自己選的第三方服務，會按它自己的條款和隱私權政策處理這些資料；渥屋助理不會把它們傳到其他地方。
translations.en: %1$@ is a third-party service you chose. It handles this data under its own terms and privacy policy; this app doesn’t send it anywhere else.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去，這家服務商也不會儲存。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent and this provider isn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去，主模型維持不變。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent and the main model stays as it is.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去：這則訊息不會送出，草稿會保留。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent: this message stays unsent and your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 之後改用別家服務商的模型時，會再問你一次。
translations.en: You’ll be asked again before a model from another provider is used.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒有送出：你沒有同意把內容傳給 %1$@。草稿已保留。
translations.en: Not sent: you didn’t agree to send your content to %1$@. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 服務商已達上限，請先刪除不用的服務商。
translations.en: You’ve reached the provider limit. Delete one you don’t use first.

translations.zh-Hant: 還沒有同意把內容傳給這家服務商，設定未變更。
translations.en: You haven’t agreed to send your content to this provider; nothing was changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 僅顯示此裝置已加密保存的完整問答。
translations.en: Only completed exchanges in this device’s encrypted archive appear here.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取加密對話；原檔保留，請解鎖後重新讀取。
translations.en: Could not read the encrypted archive. The original file is retained; unlock and reload.

translations.zh-Hant: 釘選變更未保存；對話維持原狀。請重新開啟再試。
translations.en: The pin change was not saved. The conversation is unchanged; reopen it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入非空白的單行標題，且不要過長。
translations.en: Enter a nonempty, single-line title that is not too long.

translations.zh-Hant: 改名未保存；對話內容不變。請重新開啟再試。
translations.en: The new title was not saved. The conversation is unchanged; reopen it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 任務進行中，請先返回處理。
translations.en: A task is running. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 有待核准的操作，請先返回處理。
translations.en: An action awaits your review. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 草稿或 PDF 附件未送出，請先返回處理。
translations.en: An unsent draft or PDF attachment is present. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前答覆尚未保存，請先返回處理。
translations.en: The current reply has not been saved. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務或金鑰身分不同；可在完整歷史中檢視。
translations.en: The model service or key identity differs. You can view it in full history.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取的 PDF 尚未送出；開啟新對話會移除附件。
translations.en: The selected PDF has not been sent. Starting a new conversation removes the attachment.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次回覆尚未保存；開啟新對話會清除畫面中的回覆，並放棄重試保存。
translations.en: This reply has not been saved. Starting a new conversation clears the reply and gives up the save retry.

translations.zh-Hant: 未完成的回覆片段尚未保存；開啟新對話會清除它。
translations.en: The unfinished reply preview has not been saved. Starting a new conversation clears it.

translations.zh-Hant: 已有的純文字草稿會保留。
translations.en: Your unsent text draft will remain.

translations.zh-Hant: 等待你核對個人檔案修改…
translations.en: Waiting for you to review profile changes…
Waiting for you to review memory changes…

translations.zh-Hant: 正在使用 MCP 處理對話…
請先到設定填寫模型服務與 API Key。
translations.en: Set up a model service and API key in Settings first.

translations.zh-Hant: 還缺:還沒有能用的模型
UI 測試模式：固定回覆，不會呼叫網路。
translations.en: UI test mode: fixed replies; no network calls.

translations.zh-Hant: 已完成的問答會加密保存在此裝置；未完成任務與未送出的草稿不會保存。工具操作不會還原；開啟歷史不會自動傳送。
translations.en: Completed exchanges are encrypted on this device. Unfinished tasks and unsent drafts are not saved. Tool actions are not restored, and opening history does not send anything.

translations.zh-Hant: 只搜尋本次選取並核准擷取的頁面；沒有 OCR，也不傳送資料。
translations.en: Searches only the pages selected and approved for this extraction. No OCR or data transmission.

translations.zh-Hant: 不區分英文字母大小寫（A–Z）
支援文字、.、\d、\w、\s、字元類別如 [A-Z0-9] 或 [^0-9]、+、*、固定次數 {n}（1–16）及跳脫符號；例：[A-Z]+。只列非空匹配，不支援 ?、群組、或跨行。
translations.en: Use text, ., \d, \w, \s, classes such as [A-Z0-9] or [^0-9], +, *, {n} exact repeats (1–16), and escaped symbols; e.g. [A-Z]+. Empty matches are omitted. No ?, groups, alternation, or cross-line matches.

translations.zh-Hant: 正規表示式為空或格式無效，請檢查後重試。
translations.en: The pattern is empty or malformed. Check it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此寫法尚未支援；請使用上方列出的有限語法。
translations.en: This syntax is not supported. Use the limited syntax listed above.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋已達上限而停止。若單頁過長，請改用字面搜尋；否則可縮小頁數或簡化條件。沒有顯示不完整結果。
translations.en: Search reached a limit. For an oversized single page, use literal search; otherwise select fewer pages or simplify the pattern. Partial results are not shown.

translations.zh-Hant: 輸入文字，最多 256 UTF-8 位元組
translations.en: Enter text, up to 256 UTF-8 bytes

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入 1–256 UTF-8 位元組的非空白搜尋文字，不能包含控制字元。
translations.en: Enter 1–256 UTF-8 bytes of nonblank search text without control characters.
Search did not finish. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次擷取頁面沒有符合的文字。
translations.en: No matches in the extracted pages.

translations.zh-Hant: 找到 %1$lld 處；還有其他符合位置。
這次擷取結果無法建立搜尋快照，請確認已擷取可讀取的文字。
translations.en: Could not create a search snapshot. Make sure readable text was extracted.

translations.zh-Hant: 按住說話，上滑取消，放開加入草稿。VoiceOver 可啟動開始及結束，或選擇取消語音輸入動作。
translations.en: Hold to speak, slide up to cancel, release to add to draft. With VoiceOver, activate to start and stop, or choose the cancel voice input action.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在聆聽，放開加入草稿；上滑取消
translations.en: Listening. Release to add to draft; slide up to cancel.

translations.zh-Hant: 未聽清楚，請按住說話再試一次。
translations.en: No speech recognized. Hold and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 麥克風權限已關閉，請至設定開啟後再試。
translations.en: Microphone access is off. Enable it in Settings and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音辨識權限已關閉，請至設定開啟後再試。
translations.en: Speech recognition access is off. Enable it in Settings and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此裝置的語音辨識受到限制，請檢查裝置限制。
translations.en: Speech recognition is restricted on this device. Check device restrictions.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前無法使用裝置上語音辨識，請使用鍵盤；服務商語音轉文字尚未支援。
translations.en: On-device speech recognition is unavailable. Use the keyboard; provider transcription is not yet supported.

translations.zh-Hant: 音訊無法使用或已中斷，請檢查麥克風及音訊裝置後再試。
translations.en: Audio is unavailable or was interrupted. Check your microphone and audio route, then try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音辨識逾時，請再試一次。
translations.en: Speech recognition timed out. Please try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音輸入已中斷；如果剛完成授權，請再次按住說話。
translations.en: Voice input was interrupted. If you just granted access, hold to speak again.

translations.zh-Hant: 邊說邊出字；離線辨識需支援目前語言並具備語言包
translations.en: Shows words as you speak; offline recognition requires a supported language pack

translations.zh-Hant: 這台裝置沒有可用的語音辨識
translations.en: This device has no usable speech recognition
The text box can’t be held to talk
Choose on-device recognition or turn it off

translations.zh-Hant: 語音輸入已關閉或選項不可用；請在模型設定的「語音轉文字」中選擇。
translations.en: Voice input is off or the choice is unavailable. Choose an option in model settings under Speech to text.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法儲存語音設定，請再試一次。
translations.en: Could not save the voice setting. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 你允許渥屋助理存取的照片
translations.en: Photos you let Woow Assistant access

translations.zh-Hant: 在這裡直接選照片,需要允許渥屋助理存取照片
translations.en: To pick photos here, allow Woow Assistant to access your photos

translations.zh-Hant: 不允許也可以點上面的「相簿」,用系統的照片選擇器
translations.en: Without access, tap Photos above to use the system photo picker
This attachment is no longer available
Up to %1$lld attachments at a time

translations.zh-Hant: 一次最多 %1$lld 個附件,另外 %2$lld 個沒加上
translations.en: Up to %1$lld attachments at a time; %2$lld more were not added

translations.zh-Hant: 沒能新增:%1$@(單個檔案不超過 200 MB)
translations.en: Couldn’t add: %1$@ (each file must be 200 MB or less)

translations.zh-Hant: 未確認:它能看圖就打開,聊天附上的圖片會直接交給它看。
translations.en: Not confirmed: turn this on if it can see images, and photos attached in chat go straight to it.

translations.zh-Hant: 按你的設定。打開時,聊天附上的圖片會直接交給主模型看。
translations.en: As you set it. When on, photos attached in chat go straight to the main model.

zh-Hant.other: 這個模型不能看圖,%lld 張圖片沒有交給模型。可到設定的模型頁打開「能看圖」。

en.one: This model can’t see images, so %lld image wasn’t sent to it. Turn on Sees images on the model settings page.
en.other: This model can’t see images, so %lld images weren’t sent to it. Turn on Sees images on the model settings page.

translations.en: Press and hold the text to select it
Re-add the attachments you want to include

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：API Key 無效或沒有權限。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the API key is invalid or has no access. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：額度已用完。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the account has run out of credit. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：請求太頻繁，請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: too many requests; try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：服務商那裡沒有這個模型。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the provider has no such model. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：網路連線失敗。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: couldn’t connect to the model service. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：回覆還沒傳完，連線就中斷了。請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the connection dropped before the reply finished. Try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：看不懂回傳的內容，請確認介面網址和介面類型是否相符。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: its reply couldn’t be read; check that the base URL and API type match. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：伺服器端出錯（HTTP %1$lld）。請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the server returned an error (HTTP %1$lld). Try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：伺服器端出錯（HTTP %1$lld）。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the server returned an error (HTTP %1$lld). Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.
